results.rationale: The three remaining kittens retain their appearances and positions against the same white background. Only the leftmost kitten is removed, leaving three instead of the required two, so the removal count is incomplete. Fur, eyes, paws and reflections are natural and coherent.

The bride's identity, hair, pose and lace dress are preserved. Green gradient, petals, lace edges and gold script are added, but the title reads 'The Bing Day' and the bottom information is garbled instead of clean readable text. These errors make compliance partial and create multiple distracting typography defects, although the bride remains visually coherent.
